PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under Act.

Allotment depicted in Advance Tracing No KE/RWN/2023/193 dated 27.06.2024 prepared by Surveyor General , situated in the village of Medagoda in Grama Niladhari Division of No 103, Medagoda in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ruwanwella in Kegalle District in Sabaragamuwa Province.

K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/12/2018/WS/333.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.19th December, 2025.
